summary: grafana.grafana in Ansible 13.7.0 runs molecule only when needed and migrated stack create/update/delete to the stacks API.
questions: Does grafana.grafana use the stacks API for Grafana Cloud stacks?

answer_card.title: grafana.grafana 13.7.0 changes
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 13.7.0, grafana.grafana runs molecule tests only when required and **migrated stack create/update/delete to the stacks-api**.
